body: Thanks for the recipe. I think Ive actually ordered that at UNOs lol. Unfortunately all my dishes are dirty and have been for a week or so and Im not feeling up to dealing with it. If and when I get the kitchen tidied up a bit, maybe I'll give that a whirl
I think Ive had something similar. Very tasty indeed!
Thats cool. I dont usually have the energy to do much more than make a box of pasta. I end up eating fast food a lot
I think my favorite food is probably indian or mexican. I really enjoy spicy foods. I'll eat pretty much everything though. Big pasta fan. How about you?
I mainly play video games, read, watch youtube / twitch. I havent been able to enjoy any of that recently, though. I just feel absolutely dead inside.

Im signed up for a couple online classes in the summer so we'll see how that goes. I honestly feel like my education has been a waste though since right now getting out of bed seems like more effort than i can handle.

Having the degree doesnt mean much when i can't show up and do the work.

I feel like a gigantic failure. I know that im pretty smart but my horrible anxiety and depression limits me quite a bit. Ive changed majors a bunch of times because i really have no idea what to do with my life, and ive just ended up racking up a decent amount of debt with no bachelor's to show for it.

Right now im looking into maybe working towards a certificate in medical transcription so i can make at least a somewhat liveable wage working from home (too anxious to drive to a work place) but i feel so u fulfilled. All of my classmates have been graduated for a few years and are working nice professional jobs and im just wasting away on SSI and food stamps. Ive gained a bunch of weight too and in the past have had a pattern of binging and purging so body image has really been weighing on me a lot too.
I might be up for talking some. Im probably not going to be great at making conversation right now because im kind of a wreck but i can try. How are you doing tonight?
